description: Pilot: convert the entries feature to the OOP design — rich entities (Entry/EntryMember/Waitlist/Cancellation), value objects (CancelFeePolicy, MemberComposition) and CategoryRules, EntryRepository interface + SqliteEntryRepository impl, EntryApplicationService (submit/bulkSubmit/submitWaitlist/cancel/updateMembers/listMyEntries) owning transaction boundaries via SqliteUnitOfWork, and the entries Server Actions reduced to thin 'use server' adapters delegating to the service. Behavior-preserving: Server Action names/args/return shapes (EntryActionResult, MyEntriesResult), every user-facing message (1-byte identical), the submit branch ORDER (same-day-confirm + pre-full early-return OUTSIDE the UoW; duplicate + capacity re-check + insert INSIDE), bulkSubmit per-tournament independent transactions + aggregate wording, waitlist nested branch structure, and cancel responsibility split are all preserved exactly. Reads cross the 'use server' boundary as plain DTOs (EntrySummary with EntryMemberView[]); entities never cross the boundary. Depends on FEAT-001 (uses src/domain/errors.ts + src/lib/unitOfWork.ts + src/server/container.ts). This is the pattern all later features follow.
steps: Read docs/oop-architecture.md (esp. §2.1 class-vs-DTO, §2.4 EntryRepository interface with all 11 mapped methods + countConfirmed/nextQueueNumber new, §4.1/§4.2 error+wording tables, §5 entries mapping row, §6.2 submit 4-step, §6.2.1 waitlist, §6.2.2 cancel) and .agents/tasks/design-carryover.md (Finding A: permission judgement in the service) FIRST. Read current src/features/entries/server/actions.ts, entryRepository.ts, entryViewData.ts, types/entry.ts, utils/cancelFee.ts, and src/features/tournaments/utils/category.ts to copy wording/branches/logic 1:1.

Add read-only DTO + param types to src/features/entries/types/entry.ts: EntryMemberView (read DTO, same fields as current EntryMember interface 1:1) used as EntrySummary.members element type; ListSummaryParams = { userId: string; teamId?: string | null; scope: 'personal' | 'team' }. Change EntrySummary.members to EntryMemberView[]. Keep EntryStatus/MemberType and all existing shapes identical (these cross 'use server').

Create entries/domain value objects + rules: entries/domain/CancelFeePolicy.ts (VO with new CancelFeePolicy(); calculate(eventDate, entryFee, when: Date = new Date()) returning daysBefore/feeRate/feeAmount/isPaid/adminStatus — move cancelFee.ts logic EXACTLY: toDateOnly, Math.round(diffMs/86400000) day-0 origin, >=8 ->0%, >=3 ->50% Math.floor(fee*0.5), else 100%; do NOT use Math.ceil). tournaments/domain/CategoryRules.ts (isTeamCategory/requiresLeader/requiresTeam moved from category.ts, preserving requiresLeader=isTeamCategory||DOUBLES, requiresTeam=requiresLeader). entries/domain/MemberComposition.ts (VO wrapping memberCountRange logic via CategoryRules: SINGLES 1..1, DOUBLES 2..2, team teamSizeMin??4..teamSizeMax??6). Note per design §8-3 CategoryRules lives in tournaments/domain (shared by entries pilot); import it, do not duplicate.

Create entries/domain entities: Entry.ts (fields from current Entry interface; static createConfirmed(cmd) building a CONFIRMED entry with its members; cancel(policy: CancelFeePolicy, when?: Date) that validates status==='CONFIRMED' else throws EntryNotCancellableError, calls policy.calculate(...), and returns a Cancellation entity), EntryMember.ts (write-side member entity), Waitlist.ts (static create(cmd, queueNumber)), Cancellation.ts. Keep these DB/Zod/Next-free.

Create entries/domain/EntryRepository.ts interface with the full 11-method mapping from design §2.4: findById(entryId): Entry|null; hasActiveEntry(tournamentId,userId,teamId): boolean; findSameDayActiveEntryTitles(eventDate,userId,teamId,excludeTournamentId): string[]; listMembers(entryId): EntryMemberView[]; listSummaries(params: ListSummaryParams): EntrySummary[]; listInvolvedTournamentIds({userId,teamId}): Set<string>; countConfirmed(tournamentId): number [NEW]; countActiveWaitlist(tournamentId): number; insertConfirmed(entry: Entry, members: EntryMember[]): void; updateStatus(entryId, status: EntryStatus): void; replaceMembers(entryId, members: EntryMember[]): void; insertCancellation(cancellation: Cancellation): void; hasActiveWaitlist(tournamentId,userId,teamId): boolean; nextQueueNumber(tournamentId): number [NEW]; insertWaitlist(waitlist: Waitlist): void. Repositories do NOT begin transactions.

Create entries/infrastructure/SqliteEntryRepository.ts implementing EntryRepository with constructor(private readonly db: DatabaseSync). Move entryRepository.ts SQL here; move toEntry/toEntryMember/toWaitlist/toCancellation as private row->entity factories 1:1; add private DTO builders for EntryMemberView (from listMembers) and EntrySummary (listSummaries entries+waitlists merge, preserving the exact ORDER BY and field mapping). Split the old transactional functions: createConfirmedEntry -> countConfirmed + insertConfirmed (+ hasActiveEntry already exists); createWaitlist -> hasActiveWaitlist + nextQueueNumber + insertWaitlist; cancelEntry -> updateStatus + insertCancellation; replaceEntryMembers -> replaceMembers. No BEGIN IMMEDIATE inside the repository.

Create entries/application/EntryApplicationService.ts (no 'use server'): define SubmitEntryCommand (from CreateEntryParams) and the SubmitOutcome discriminated union ({kind:'confirmed';entry:Entry} | {kind:'preFull'}) plus SubmitWaitlistCommand. Constructor injects SqliteUnitOfWork + EntryRepository + TournamentRepository + TeamRepository + UserRepository + NotificationService interfaces (TournamentRepository/TeamRepository/UserRepository/NotificationService are minimal interfaces the entries service needs; define thin ones in entries/domain or import if a later feature owns them — for the pilot, define the minimal interfaces needed and wire concrete Sqlite impls in container.ts). Implement submit exactly per §6.2 4-step (steps 1-3 OUTSIDE uow.run with TournamentNotOpenError, PERMISSION judgement in the SERVICE per Finding A, MemberComposition check, same-day ConflictConfirmationRequiredError, pre-full -> return {kind:'preFull'}; step 4 INSIDE uow.run: DuplicateEntryError re-check, canAcceptEntry/EntryFullError, Entry.createConfirmed + insertConfirmed). submitWaitlist exactly per §6.2.1 preserving the nested requiresTeam branch (leaderOnlyWaitlist + teamOwnership only inside requiresTeam; SINGLES never reaches them). cancel exactly per §6.2.2 (findById->NotFoundError, permission in the service, Entry.cancel(new CancelFeePolicy(), when) OUTSIDE uow; updateStatus + insertCancellation INSIDE uow). updateMembers (permission in the service, 3-day-before limit check preserved, replaceMembers inside uow). bulkSubmit calls submit per tournament, each its own uow.run; do NOT wrap the whole bulk in one uow. listMyEntries composes EntrySummary DTOs. Permission judgement for ALL FOUR use cases lives here (Finding A), same wording/branches relocated from the adapter.

Create the adapter's pure mapper entries/server/toActionResult.ts (or inline in actions.ts): toActionResult(error|outcome, context?) mapping DomainError/PermissionContext and SubmitOutcome.preFull to the EXACT user-facing strings in design §4.2 (a)(b), 1-byte identical to current actions.ts. Map DB/unknown exceptions to the per-operation generic catch strings (submit/waitlist/cancel/updateMembers) from §4.2.

Rewrite src/features/entries/server/actions.ts into thin 'use server' adapters: keep EntryActionResult, MyEntriesResult, and all exported action names/signatures identical; each action does session + Zod parse (early return with current wording) + build service via createEntryApplicationService() (add this factory to src/server/container.ts wiring SqliteEntryRepository/SqliteTournamentRepository/SqliteTeamRepository/SqliteUserRepository/NotificationService — define minimal Sqlite adapters over the existing repository functions where a full feature impl does not exist yet, so entries can wire today without touching other features' internals beyond their public functions) + call the service + toActionResult mapping + revalidatePath + logNotification AFTER commit (preserve ENTRY_CONFIRMED / CANCEL_FREE|CANCEL_PAID_USER|CANCEL_PAID_ADMIN timing and payload wording). bulkSubmit adapter wraps each submit in try/catch folding to { tournamentId, ok, message } with acknowledgeConflict propagated to all; aggregate message `${results.length}件中 ${okCount}件のエントリーが完了しました。`, ok = okCount>0.

Move entries unit tests to the new API and add service unit tests: since there are currently NO tests for cancelFee.ts/category.ts, add new unit tests under entries/domain/__tests__ for CancelFeePolicy (boundaries: 8-day ->0%, 3-day ->50% Math.floor, 2-day/past ->100%; Math.round day-diff) and MemberComposition/CategoryRules; add EntryApplicationService unit tests with an in-memory EntryRepository fake covering submit branches (not open / permission / member range / same-day confirm / pre-full / duplicate re-check / TOCTOU full), waitlist nested branches (SINGLES does not emit leader wording), cancel (not cancellable, free vs paid wording + admin notification), bulk aggregate wording. Follow the vitest + fast-check patterns in src/features/data/utils/__tests__.

Remove the now-empty src/features/entries/utils/cancelFee.ts only after grep-confirming no out-of-feature import remains (design §5 requires grepping the 4 helper types CreateEntryParams/CreateEntryResult/WaitlistResult/CancelEntryParams for external imports before deleting; the Result types are dropped in favor of exceptions). Keep tournaments/utils/category.ts callers working (tournaments feature still imports it until FEAT-003; re-export from CategoryRules or leave category.ts delegating to CategoryRules to avoid breaking tournaments/auth now).
Verify entries still builds and all tests (old + new) pass; confirm no class instance crosses 'use server' (EntrySummary.members is EntryMemberView[], not an entity).
acceptance_criteria: Server Action exports in src/features/entries/server/actions.ts are unchanged in name/signature and EntryActionResult/MyEntriesResult shapes are unchanged.
Every user-facing message string is 1-byte identical to the pre-refactor actions.ts (verified by the toActionResult mapping tests).

submit executes same-day-confirm and pre-full OUTSIDE the UoW (early return) and duplicate+capacity re-check+insert INSIDE; pre-full wording ('満員です。キャンセル待ちへご登録ください。') and TOCTOU wording ('直前に満員となりました。…') are distinct paths.
submitWaitlist keeps leaderOnlyWaitlist/teamOwnership nested inside requiresTeam (SINGLES waitlist shows no leader-only message).
cancel computes fee + builds Cancellation outside the UoW and only updateStatus+insertCancellation run inside it; notifications logged after commit with free/paid split.
bulkSubmit runs each submit in its own transaction and returns `${results.length}件中 ${okCount}件のエントリーが完了しました。` with ok = okCount>0.
Permission judgement for submit/submitWaitlist/cancel/updateMembers lives in EntryApplicationService (Finding A), not the adapter.
DB schema (src/lib/db.ts) unchanged; no any introduced; SQL only in SqliteEntryRepository.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; npm test passes (previous 43 + new entries tests); npm run build succeeds (external SQLite-lock caveat per context.json).
verification: npx vitest run src/features/entries  (expect new entries/domain + application tests pass)
npm test  (expect all prior tests still pass plus the new ones; dataRepository.results.test.ts Property 7 still passes)
npm run build  (expect success; on SQLite 'database is locked' apply the external-lock caveat from context.json)
findings:
entries パイロットを OOP 化して完了。全 3 ゲート green（npx vitest run src/features/entries=45 新規 pass / npm test=88 passed・16 files・Property 7 も pass / npx tsc --noEmit=exit0 / npm run build=exit0 成功: 今回は外部 SQLite ロックに阻まれなかった）。

【後続 FEAT が従うパターン・再利用できる配線】
- 依存の最小 interface を entries/domain/dependencies.ts に定義（TournamentView/TournamentRepository, TeamView/TeamRepository, UserView/UserRepository, NotificationService）。container.ts が既存公開関数（findTournamentWithStats/findTeamById/findTeamByLeader/findUserById/logNotification）の上に薄く配線。FEAT-003+ で tournaments/teams/auth/notifications を本格 OOP 化する際は、これらを本物の Sqlite*Repository / *ApplicationService へ差し替えるだけでよい（entries 側は無改修）。
- toActionResult（entries/server/toActionResult.ts）は operation 別（submit/waitlist/cancel/updateMembers）の汎用 catch 文言と、NotFoundError.context（entry/user/tournament/team）・PermissionDeniedError.context（5 種）別文言を 1 バイト一致でマップ。横展開でも同型の純関数マッパ方式を踏襲する。
- 権限判定は 4 ユースケースすべて EntryApplicationService に集約済み（Finding A 解消）。アダプタは session+Zod+配線+例外→Result+revalidate+COMMIT 後通知のみ。

【errors.ts への追加（共有・後続も利用可）】
- NotFoundError に context: NotFoundContext('entry'|'user'|'tournament'|'team') を付与（コンストラクタ必須引数）。FEAT-001 の NotFoundError を参照する箇所は現状なし。
- 新規: TeamRequiredError('TEAM_REQUIRED'), MemberUpdateDeadlineError('MEMBER_UPDATE_DEADLINE')。MemberCompositionError は (min,max) を保持するコンストラクタ付きに変更。いずれも『前提/入力エラーを DomainError 化しつつアダプタで文言化』方針。

【insertConfirmed の契約微調整】
- EntryRepository.insertConfirmed(entry, members) は void ではなく採番した entries.id を string で返す（完了画面・通知で現行どおり entryId を返すため）。他の分解メソッドは設計どおり void。

【未削除（意図的・契約維持）】
- src/features/entries/server/entryRepository.ts は削除していない。listInvolvedTournamentIds を src/app/(user)/tournaments/page.tsx が import しているため（feature 外依存あり）。SQL は SqliteEntryRepository に移植済みだが当面重複共存。FEAT-003（tournaments）で page.tsx の依存を解消してから entryRepository.ts の縮退/削除を検討すること。
- entries/utils/cancelFee.ts と tournaments/utils/category.ts は削除せず CancelFeePolicy / CategoryRules+MemberComposition への薄い委譲ラッパとして残置（CancelEntryModal / EntryModal / WaitlistModal / GuidelinesViewer などクライアント/他 feature が import しているため）。

【設計との差分・判断】
- cancel の順序は設計 §6.2.2 に従い findById→権限→tournament 取得→Entry.cancel(status 検証) とした（現行アダプタは status 検証が tournament 取得より前だったが、設計書が authoritative のため設計順を採用）。観測可能なのは『未確定エントリー かつ 大会も無い』稀ケースのみ。
- Tournament の remaining/canAcceptEntry/isOpen は FEAT-003 までの暫定として dependencies.ts の TournamentView（容量ベースの派生判定）で表現。FEAT-003 で Tournament エンティティへ吸収する際に置換する。

【新規テスト】entries/domain/__tests__/{CancelFeePolicy,MemberComposition}.test.ts, entries/application/__tests__/EntryApplicationService.test.ts（インメモリ fake + fake UoW）, entries/server/__tests__/toActionResult.test.ts（文言 1 バイト一致）。
